title: 第4章
content_zh: 初到异世 004，夫君桌子中央有油灯，油灯下是两块小石头，涟漪料想这就是传说中的火石。她是城市里长大的孩子，没经历过农村生活，但好歹是有生活常识和想象力。将火石碰撞，擦出了火花，油灯点亮。黑暗的房内因为有了这盏小灯明亮很多，当涟漪靠着这微弱的光线看清犹如垃圾回收站的房内时，她已经淡定了。她不是从前的苏涟漪，有一天也许会离开这里追求她想要的生活，但在熟悉这个世界之前，这里还是她的安身之所。既来之则安之，与其这么抱怨环境的不好，还不如自己动手好好收拾一下。房间深处是一只雕花大床，上面的被子乌黑黑不提，一旁有个梳妆台。涟漪到梳妆台上翻找，在第二个抽屉里找到了一把剪刀。拿着剪刀到“垃圾堆”，随便抓了一块看起来吸水能力最好的衣物，刷刷几剪子，将衣物剪成几块布，姑且就拿这个做抹布吧。虽然房间里脏乱，但该有的都有，可见当初家人为她置办家具时的细心。厨房有三只大木盆，涟漪将木盆搬到院子中，把房间内和院子一旁摆的所有脏衣服都堆到盆旁，一会准备挑出来先洗几件应急。房间入门左手边有一个木架子，架子上有一只灵巧的小盆，蓄上水，将之前剪好的布子弄湿，开始卖力气的擦灰。雕花大床不算是什么珍品，但若是放到现代，也能值个几万。涟漪一边将大床擦出本来颜色，一边的感慨，在现代不是复古的人，跑到古代竟能睡这种极品的床。从前只在电视上看过铜镜，如今她算是开了眼界。还别说，这铜镜打磨得十分光整，当擦干净了镜面，竟能将人清清楚楚的映出，除了看不清颜色，其他的都不错。苏涟漪埋头苦干了大概一个时辰，在天完全黑下来后，终于将屋内擦了个遍。也许是因将脏衣服都扔到了院子，也许是因为通风了许久，更也许是涟漪将屋子摆设擦的干干净净，此时的屋内全然没了刺鼻味，只有一股干净的气息，还有淡淡的香味。香味？自然是涟漪从屋子角落里偶然发现的皂角粉，为了去味，在盆子中除了放皂角粉，还放了一些本尊的香粉。涟漪扔了抹布，跌坐在一旁的椅子上，环顾四周，虽然累得汗流浃背，但看着自己的劳动成果，心情却突然转好了起来。肚子咕噜一响，摸了摸圆滚滚的肥肉，涟漪忍不住失笑，“从前不是胖人无法了解，原来胖子也会饿啊。”她不是在辱骂胖人，而是在消遣自己。自己动手丰衣足食，她向厨房走去，好在刚刚她收拾厨房时还发现了一些米面和蔬菜，应该不会饿肚子。房门有着高高的门槛，是当地的建筑风格，涟漪刚刚来回几趟，差点被这高门槛绊倒几回，如今有了防备，过门槛时一直低头死死盯着，但，防住了门槛，却差点不小心撞上迎面走来的人。苏涟漪即便是未抬头，还是隐隐感觉到前方有抹高大的身影。不知何时，她面前竟然无声无息出现一人，当涟漪看到那人脸的时候，大吃一惊。……夜色全黑，晚风吹过，树叶飒飒作响。屋内唯有一盏小油灯，院子中没有照明，还好快到十五，月亮很大，洒下一片银光。苏涟漪感觉到身前有黑影压来，猛的一抬头。不看还好，一看忍不住倒吸一口气，这是……这是狗熊！？那抹身影高大魁梧，宽阔的肩膀窄细的腰，按现代的身高标准，定然超过一米八五。但这身影丝毫没有人样——长长的头发如同杂草一般，身上的衣服也是破破烂烂。涟漪猛地向后退了几步，这大半夜的单身女子碰见虎背熊腰又满身狼狈的男人，凶多吉少！刚刚收拾屋子的时候，她记得门后有一根木棍，二话不说便操了起来。“什么人，竟敢擅闯民居，赶紧滚，再不滚我就不客气了！”一边恐吓，一边抽出那木棍，摆起了准备进攻的姿势。隐约感觉到那人顿了一下，但马上就如同没听见她说话一般，向屋内走去。男人近了，借着微弱的灯光，涟漪看清了人，更是紧张。这人衣服破破烂烂不说，脸上、胳膊上的皮肤没一块是干净的，满是泥泞，分明就是流民！苏涟漪心扑通扑通直跳，饶是再淡定，此时也有想哭的欲望了。死后穿越，刚穿越来差点就被投井，如今终于脱离了陷阱，夜晚还要遭遇流氓，若是劫财她就认了，千万不能劫色，让她失身还不如直接让她去死！想到这，她二话不说，一棒子便挥了过去，先发制人。对面那高大之人，满是污泥的脸上有一双冷冽的眼，眼中带着不屑。他的手动了一下，好像是要下意识挡挥来的木棒，但也仅仅是动了一下，又将手放回，直愣愣的看着木棍打上自己胸膛。“啪”的一声巨响，木棍折成两段，可见苏涟漪用力之狠，但，男人却纹丝不动，好像刚刚打在他身上的不是木棍而是一缕柔丝一般，继续向着她走。涟漪别说哭，想死得心都有了，她可怎么办？让她意外的事发生了，男人直接越过了他，走进了房间。涟漪一愣，这人不是来行凶的？看样子他对这里还很熟，这人到底是谁？男人走入房间后也愣住了，冷冽的眼中扫过惊讶，而后向左看看，又向右看看，好像一个人进错了房间一般愕然。苏涟漪突然脑海中闪过一个想法——这男人，该不会就是她……她那个夫君吧？男人正在惊讶，背对着涟漪，后者只能看见他宽厚的背和挺直的脊梁，以及完美的身材。刚刚因太过害怕没留意，如今仔细看去，这男人的身材真是好。身高先不说，就这一双修长笔直的腿，便能媲美模特，还有宽厚的背，即便是隔着破烂的衣物，也能感受到他极有张力的背部肌肉。他的头发虽疏于打理而肮脏打结，但却能看出这乌黑的发丝若是洗涤后定然黑亮。“大……虎？”苏涟漪试探的问，声音犹豫，如果她没记错，本尊的夫君应该就是叫大虎。
content_en: When he first arrived in the different world 004, there was an oil lamp in the middle of the husband's table. Under the oil lamp were two small stones. Lianyi guessed that these were the legendary flints. She grew up in a city and has never experienced rural life, but she has common sense and imagination. The flint was collided, sparks were created, and the oil lamp was lit. The dark room was much brighter because of this small lamp. When Lianyi relied on this weak light to see clearly into the room that looked like a garbage recycling bin, she was already calm. She is not the Su Lianyi she used to be. One day she may leave here to pursue the life she wants, but until she gets familiar with the world, this is still her place to stay. Let's take care of things as they come. Instead of complaining about the bad environment, it's better to take care of it yourself. Deep in the room is a large carved bed with a jet black quilt and a dressing table beside it. Ripple rummaged around on the dressing table and found a pair of scissors in the second drawer. Take the scissors to the "garbage dump", grab a piece of clothing that seems to have the best absorbency, use the scissors a few times, cut the clothing into several pieces of cloth, and use this as a rag for the time being. Although the room was dirty and messy, it had everything it needed, which shows that her family had taken great care when buying furniture for her. There were three large wooden basins in the kitchen. Ripple moved the wooden basins to the yard and piled all the dirty clothes in the room and the yard next to the basins. He was going to pick out a few emergency items to wash first. There is a wooden shelf on the left hand side of the entrance to the room. There is a smart little basin on the shelf. Fill it with water. Wet the cloth you cut earlier and start to wipe the dust vigorously. The large carved bed is not a treasure, but in modern times it would be worth tens of thousands. While Lianyi wiped out the original color of the big bed, he sighed that he was not a retro person in modern times, but he could sleep on such a top-notch bed in ancient times. She had only seen bronze mirrors on TV before, but now her eyes had been opened. Not to mention, this bronze mirror was polished very smoothly. When the surface of the mirror was wiped clean, it could reflect people clearly. Except for the unclear color, everything else was good. Su Lianyi worked hard for about an hour, and after it became completely dark, she finally wiped the entire house. Maybe it was because the dirty clothes were thrown into the yard, maybe it was because it had been ventilated for a long time, or maybe it was because the ripples wiped the furnishings in the house clean. At this time, there was no pungent smell in the house, only a clean breath and a light fragrance. fragrance? Naturally, Lianyi accidentally discovered the soap locust powder from the corner of the house. In order to remove the smell, in addition to the soap locust powder, he also put some of the deity's fragrant powder in the basin. Ripple threw away the rag, sat down on a chair nearby, and looked around. Although he was sweating from exhaustion, his mood suddenly improved when he looked at the fruits of his labor. Her stomach growled and she touched the round fat. She couldn't help laughing, "It wasn't fat people who couldn't understand it before. It turns out that fat people can also be hungry." She was not insulting fat people, but amusing herself. After making enough food and clothing by herself, she walked to the kitchen. Fortunately, when she was cleaning up the kitchen, she found some rice noodles and vegetables, so she wouldn't be hungry. The door has a high threshold, which is the local architectural style. Ripple has just gone back and forth a few times and almost tripped over the high threshold a few times. Now he is on guard and keeps looking down when he crosses the threshold. However, after guarding against the threshold, he almost accidentally bumps into the person walking towards him. Even though Su Lianyi didn't raise her head, she still vaguely felt a tall figure in front of her. At some point, a person appeared silently in front of her. When Ripple saw that person's face, she was shocked. ...The night is completely dark, the evening wind blows, and the leaves rustle. There was only a small oil lamp in the house, and there was no lighting in the yard. Fortunately, it was almost fifteen, and the moon was very big, casting a silvery light. Su Lianyi felt a dark shadow pressing in front of her and raised her head sharply. It's okay if you don't look at it, but when you look at it, you can't help but take a breath, this is... this is a bear! ? The figure was tall and burly, with broad shoulders and a narrow waist. According to modern height standards, he must be over 1.85 meters. But this figure didn't look human at all - his hair was as long as weeds, and his clothes were in tatters. Lianyi took a few steps back suddenly. It was very unlucky for a single woman in the middle of the night to encounter a man with a heavy back and a heavy body. When she was just cleaning up the house, she remembered there was a wooden stick behind the door and started fucking it without saying a word. "Who dares to break into a house without permission? Get out now. If you don't get out, I won't be polite!" While threatening, he pulled out the wooden stick and got ready to attack. She vaguely felt that the person paused, but immediately walked toward the house as if he didn't hear her. The man was closer, and with the faint light, Ripple could see the man clearly, and he became even more nervous. Not to mention the tattered clothes of this man, the skin on his face and arms was not clean and covered with mud. He was clearly a refugee! Su Lianyi's heart was pounding. No matter how calm she was, she felt like crying at this time. She traveled through time after death. She almost got thrown into a well when she first traveled through time. Now she finally escaped from the trap. She also encountered gangsters at night. If he wanted to rob money, she would accept it. He must not rob her for sex. It would be better to let her die than to let her lose her virginity! Thinking of this, without saying a word, she swung the stick and struck preemptively. The tall man opposite had a pair of cold eyes with disdain on his muddy face. He moved his hand, as if to subconsciously block the swinging wooden stick, but he only moved it briefly, then put his hand back, and watched blankly as the wooden stick hit his chest. There was a loud "snap" sound, and the wooden stick broke into two pieces, which showed how hard Su Lianyi used it. However, the man did not move at all, as if what had just hit him was not a wooden stick but a strand of soft silk, and continued to walk towards her. Don't even cry, Lianyi wants to die. What can she do? Something unexpected happened to her. The man passed him directly and walked into the room. Lianyi was stunned,
